input: Look into pet insurance for the cat

gold.taskTitle: Research and choose pet insurance for cat
gold.taskDescription: Look into pet insurance options for the user's cat and determine the best plan to pursue.

questions.title: How old is your cat right now?
questions.description: Age affects eligibility and premium pricing across most pet insurance providers.

questions.title: Does your cat have any pre-existing medical conditions?
questions.description: Pre-existing conditions are often excluded or affect which plans are available.

questions.title: Is your cat indoor-only or does it go outside?
questions.description: Lifestyle affects the level of coverage needed and risk factors insurers consider.

questions.title: What is your monthly budget for the premium?
questions.description: Knowing the budget narrows down which plans and tiers are realistic options.

questions.title: Do you want accident-only or comprehensive illness coverage?
questions.description: This determines the core type of plan to focus research on.

questions.title: Is there a specific vet or clinic you already use?
questions.description: Some insurance plans have network restrictions or reimbursement differences depending on the vet.

questions.title: What is your target deadline to have a plan chosen?
questions.description: A deadline helps prioritize urgency and structure the research timeline.
